headline: Not recalled, but other buyers report safety problems. Check yours.

steps.title: Check yours for: USB-C port overheating during charging
steps.detail: 9 buyers reported this, 4 with photos. Don't use it unattended, overnight, or on a bed or sofa, and unplug it when you're not using it. Stop using it if it gets very hot, smells of burning, swells or shows scorch marks.

steps.title: If yours shows the same problem, stop using it and ask for a return
steps.detail: Contact the seller or marketplace while the return window is open, and describe what you saw. A photo helps.

steps.title: Report what happened to you
steps.detail: If it hurt someone, overheated, sparked or broke dangerously, report it. SafeShelf can pre-fill the regulator's form from its case file; you check it and submit it yourself.

steps.title: Save it to My Shelf
steps.detail: SafeShelf tells you if it is recalled later.

regulator.name: National Consumer Helpline, India (with the BIS registration number if the label shows one)
